title: device-ness asks the shim get status: the health clause is built
intention: Device-ness is answered whole: a device is fitted at the rack and its shim answers get status.
why: 2026-11-12: cairn/tools/base/deviceness.py:55 HEALTH_QUERY_CLAUSE still reads 'UNBUILT - no health-query protocol exists on the bus' (measured 2026-08-11), and is_device() answers the fitted clause only. Since then every shim answers the root view status (cairn/tools/base/shim.py:68 ROOT_VIEWS, :1317), and ticket 7cb1989e7825 (PROVED) maps 'every device answers a health query' to the bus tooth 'the bus answers get status'. 74d4124bc0e7 (PROVED) has a falsifier with two clauses, fitted AND answers a health query over the bus. Outline 5.8.3.2.3: the shim answers what it can; for a health question it holds no answer to, it wakes the device and asks.
traces_to: 74d4124bc0e7 (device-ness is decided at the shim; its falsifier's second clause); outline 5.8.3.2.3 (the shim answers a health question, waking the device if it must); f5dbfddea8c6 (no rule rests as policy; this was the deviceness site).
how: deviceness gains answers_health(device_id, ask) that asks the device's shim `get status` through an injected ask callable (the bus client's in the live path) and reads True when the reply is exit 0 with data not None; HEALTH_QUERY_CLAUSE is replaced by the clause's built reading, which names get status and shim.py; divergence() reports per-device answered/not-answered when given an ask, and keeps the fitted axis alone when not. is_device stays the fitted predicate; a new is_live_device(candidate, ask) is fitted AND answers_health. Proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_deviceness_asks_health.py.

clauses.claim: answers_health reads True for a fake shim whose get status replies exit 0 with data, and False for one that refuses, raises, or replies data None
is_live_device is False for a fitted device whose shim does not answer, and True for one that does; is_device is unchanged for both
deviceness.py no longer says UNBUILT, and HEALTH_QUERY_CLAUSE names get status at cairn/tools/base/shim.py

decisions.text: D1: the ask is injected (a callable taking device id, verb, view and returning the shim's reply dict); the live path passes the bus client's ask, the proof passes fakes. No bus is opened inside deviceness.
D2: is_device keeps its signature and answer; is_live_device is the whole predicate.

D3: the constant rides two readers, the probe's payload (key predicate_is_half_built, kept as the wire name with the built clause as its value; its against_falsifier text restated) and test_deviceness's tooth test_the_unbuilt_half_is_declared_not_omitted, which now asserts the clause names get status. Both are in bounds.

Assert carried['predicate_is_half_built'] == HEALTH_QUERY_CLAUSE, that carried['against_falsifier'] contains 'is_live_device' and 'get status', and that its lowercase does not contain 'unbuilt'. Extend the docstring's clause 3 to name D3. Verify: the three teeth stay green on the current code, and the hollow run reverting the probe to its text at git commit bb1f2409de92 (which still said the asking half is unbuilt) reds this tooth.
